title: Normalized rational root bases compatible with finite field inclusions
statement: Fix a scheme X and a prime ell invertible on X. Let W be a pro-etale object and let zeta_n and e_n be the compatible root sections and normalized slice-module bases of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. Let A(E)=E_X be the pulled-back continuous-function coefficient diagram, M(E)=E_X(1) its specified rational twist diagram, and O restriction to the slice over W. There is a natural isomorphism b: A composed with O -> M composed with O. For each E its component is E_X|W-linear: multiplication followed by b_E equals identity tensor b_E followed by the specified rational twist action (using the lax monoidal comparison of O). This statement takes neither the colimit over E nor positive tensor powers.

proof.text: Use spRootBasisLevel at each n to choose its normalized coefficient-to-twist basis. Restrict naturality of the root transition to each slice object and use h_zeta; tensor naturality then proves the successor squares. NatTrans.ofOpSequence assembles these into a natural isomorphism, retaining the component formula instead of forgetting it.

proof.text: Apply section reconstruction and slice restriction to the coefficient cone and the actual twist limit cone. Sectionwise evaluation shows both remain limit cones. Transport the coefficient cone along the normalized tower isomorphism and take the unique limit-point isomorphism. Lift its section-linear map to an internal slice-module isomorphism by tensor-sheaf hom extensionality. The limit comparison equations preserve its normalized formula on every projection.

proof.text: For E contained in F, compare the two integral basis composites using the underlying slice limit cone of F. Its projections reduce the equation to the normalized finite-level formula, the specified square for spEllMap, and lax tensor naturality with the identity on roots. Thus the constructed integral bases, with their actual actions, commute with field inclusions.

proof.text: Extend each prescribed integral slice basis using the normalized scalar-extension lemma. The tensor normalization of the actual rational transition implies its naturality on extension units. Regard both sides of the desired rational naturality square as linear maps from the regular E coefficient module, with the F target restricted along E -> F. Mod.regular_hom_ext reduces their equality to their value on one. The normalized scalar-extension equation, integral naturality, and ring-map unit equations prove this equality. Assemble the components with NatIso.ofComponents. Their Mod.act_hom identities are exactly the required displayed action equations.

theorem spRationalRootDiagramBasis
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (ℓ : X.residueField x)] (W : X.ProEt)
    (ζ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.obj (op W))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n))).over W ≅
        (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).over W)
    (hζ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTransition X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) (ℓ ^ (n + 2))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _)
        (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))).hom.app (op W) (ζ (n + 1)) = ζ n)
    (he : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : (Over W)ᵒᵖ)
      (a : ((Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n)).over W).obj.obj V),
      (e n).hom.val.app V a =
        a • (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.map V.unop.hom.op (ζ n)) :
    let A := Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjFunctor.{u} ℓ ⋙ upperStarFromPoint X
    let O := (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W
    ∃ b : A ⋙ O ≅ spRationalTwistDiagram X ℓ ⋙ O,
      ∀ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ O (A.obj E) (A.obj E) ≫
            O.map (MonObj.mul (X := condensedRingObj.{u}
              (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) X)) ≫ b.hom.app E =
          O.obj (A.obj E) ◁ b.hom.app E ≫
            Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ O (A.obj E) (spRationalTwist X ℓ E).X ≫
              O.map (Mod.act (A := condensedRingObj.{u}
                (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) X) (spRationalTwist X ℓ E).X)
